It's always been like this.
I tend to wear out my shoes quickly.

Ya gotta show everyone what yer made of and debut ASAP.
Besides, I wanna race ya again myself!

Her incredible leg power is as formidable as ever,
tearing into the turf...!

Oh, right... I apologize for asking so much,
but could you give me directions one more time?
In that case...!

As she spoke, a fierce resolve
gleamed in Oguri Cap's eyes—

With that, Oguri Cap briskly ran off.
However—
Of course.

Running in the Debut Selection will bring me closer to my Twinkle Series debut.
...I need to train hard.
...That's why I love running.

...Everyone back home told me,
'Seeing you run with a smile brings us more joy than anything.'

I'll help ya pick out
the sturdiest pair they got!
Haa... Alright, one more set...!

Suddenly, Oguri Cap
crouched down on the spot!

Wait, huh? Ain't you that rookie Trainer
who's always hangin' around Oguri lately?

...As expected, the forest air is wonderful.
It clears my mind and brings me peace.

That race with Tama the other day... was fun.
Even now, just remembering it makes my heart race.
Ah, don't worry about it, totally fine!

...Ah, I've spent too much time chatting.
I must get back to training.

Back in the day, I used to run around places like this all the time.
Then the folks back home suggested I try racing as an Umamusume.

If debuting means I can have exciting races
against rivals as strong and fast as Tama—
Ah...

Hahh, I get it now. Man, Oguri didn't even realize
it herself...? Seriously, what a space cadet.
Yes. ...Everyone cheered me on.

After retying her shoelace,
Oguri Cap started running again.

Thanks for guiding me, it really helped.
I feel like I can run here while remembering where I started.

With Tamamo Cross's help,
we picked out shoes capable of withstanding Oguri Cap's running...

I love running in races
and bringing excitement to everyone.

Apparently, someone from the academy saw my race with Tama
and granted me special permission.

If things continue like this, Oguri Cap
might not be able to perform at her best.

Registration had already closed
by the time I transferred here, but—

A few days after the mock race with Tamamo Cross—
I spotted Oguri Cap training diligently.

Well, whatever, count me in! The selection race is yer chance
to show Trainers what ya got. Leavin' things like this ain't fair.

Whenever I raced, everyone would gather to feast together that night.
Win or lose, we always did.
Somewhere around here with plenty of nature, if possible.
I want to make my debut as soon as possible.

"That was amazing," "You gave me energy," "Keep enjoying your runs"
...I was always surrounded by words like that.

Ah... No, that's not it.
My shoelace just snapped.

Taking a closer look upon hearing that,
Oguri Cap's shoes were indeed quite battered.

The day of my first regional race, they made a grand banner for me.
...Even though everyone was so busy with farm work.
Well, excuse me.
I'll have to go buy a replacement soon...

...What's with the funky look on yer face?
Somethin' happen?

Alright, let's go pick 'em out!
So, what's our budget? That's the most important part, ain't it?!

Yes. ...Actually, I've been given permission
to enter the upcoming Debut Selection race.
I explained the situation to Tamamo Cross...

Even so, the condition of those shoes was unusual. Ordinary shoes
likely couldn't withstand the immense power of her stride tearing up the track.

Mmm, as usual, every single pair
costs a pretty penny...
Hm? You are...

Hm...?
What's the matter? You look so pale.

To think there was a forest like this behind the academy... What a great discovery.
Thank you.

As I watched, completely mesmerized
by the intensity of her training—
